title: Cut lore 0.4.5
description: LCLI-446 (plugin-sourced SKILL.md label fix) has been held on dev since #597; the user lifted the hold via AskUserQuestion and approved cutting 0.4.5 now, carrying it plus LCLI-453 (OPAG-61 fleet block sync) and LCLI-452 over main. Version bump 0.4.4 -> 0.4.5 across package.json, all six npm/<platform>/package.json manifests, the six optionalDependencies pins, and .claude-plugin/plugin.json; regenerate bun.lock under the pinned Bun; refresh the three version-bearing Ladybug digest baselines; move CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] under [0.4.5]; update README version-status line.

implementationNotes: Released. Tag v0.4.5 at 70d61df (fast-forward from f7bc267, verified by git rev-parse equality on main/dev). PR #600 promotion ran the full main-triggered CI matrix, all green.
